text:
jordan: Quick kickoff 
We have a cross-partner integration to land: VaultEdge HSM (hardware), NorthStar SI, and CloudMarket listing. Goal: SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning + HSM-backed KMS for signing. Need a compact playbook and owners. Target soft launch: 2024-12-03. Can we split owners?

sana: I can take product+marketplace listing. Need a 1-paragraph description, 3 feature bullets, and partner logos. Also ask partners for any co-branding guidelines.

tomas: I'll own engineering for the HSM/KMS path. Requirements from my side: vendor HSM PCI attestation doc, accepted cipher suites, and module api (pkcs11 endpoint). We should require pci_level >= 2 and firmware >= 3.0.0.

ravi: Security/compliance: confirm if private key material ever leaves HSM. If partner does remote signing, we need an SLA and audit trail. Also want a short customer checklist for onboarding (network ports, ip allowlist, TLS mutual auth).

jordan: Good. Proposed owners: Tomas=engineering integration + test harness, Sana=marketplace + comms, Ravi=security & compliance checklist, Jordan=release coordination + legal ping.

marketing-bot: marketing-task: create draft blurb when Sana uploads requirements.

sana: Draft blurb for review: "Redwood integrates with VaultEdge HSM via NorthStar SI to provide SAML/SCIM identity flows and HSM-backed key operations for enterprise signing and encryption." Bullets: "1) SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, 2) HSM-backed KMS with PKCS#11 support, 3) Marketplace provisioning and one-click onboarding."

jordan: Good start. Tomas, partners want sample SCIM mapping. Can you paste a minimal mapping we can include?

tomas: Minimal SCIM sample below (we'll include group->role mapping in docs):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "id": "user.id",
  "userName": "user.login",
  "emails": [{"value":"user.email","primary":true}],
  "roles": "urn:custom:roles"
}
```

ravi: For verifying KMS/HSM after provisioning, include multi-cloud checks. Examples: Azure, AWS, and a local HSM attest command.

```bash
# AWS quick check
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/Redwood-HSM | jq .KeyState
# Azure quick check
az keyvault key show --vault-name <VAULT> --name <KEY_NAME>
# HSM local attest
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libvauth.so -O
```

sana: For SAML metadata, partners asked for our test endpoint and cert. We'll give them: https://console.redwood.ai/saml/test-metadata and a test cert thumbprint. Note: rotate after prod.

jordan: Ops note: We'll run a staged rollout in Redwood Dedicated: route 2% traffic to HSM-backed route for the first day, increase to 20% after stability. Configure automatic fallback to software-KMS on error and set alert on >0.5% error rate in canary.

deploy-bot: canary-config: created in staging. Dry-run scheduled 2024-11-28 22:00 UTC.

tomas: Tests: SAML login, SCIM create/update, key sign/verify using HSM, latency baselines (95th p50) under expected traffic. I'll provide a test matrix and harness by EOD Tue.

ravi: Legal ask: ensure data residency + key custody language in partner agreement. If signing happens in partner cloud, customers must opt-in. Flagging for legal.

sana: Marketing: need a short quote from a partner rep for the marketplace listing. I'll request and set deadline Thu.

jordan: Action items recap:
- Tomas: test harness + SCIM mapping + PKCS#11 example (due Tue)
- Sana: marketplace draft + partner logos + quote request (due Thu)
- Ravi: security checklist + network onboarding steps + legal flags (due Thu)
- Jordan: partner legal intro + rollout plan + press coordination (due Mon)

sana: ack, will start the CloudMarket listing draft and ping partners for logos.

tomas: ack, will post test vectors here and include latency expectations.

ravi: ack, will draft the compliance checklist and share.

jordan: thanks everyone. I'll create a single playbook doc and link it here once available. If anyone needs a reassignment, call it out. Otherwise I'll start legal loop and schedule a partner sync next week. :rocket:
